title: 第5章 名震宗门第6章 穿云拔剑术
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
但是境界不够，弊端也很明显，威力上就不能发挥到极致，而且由于真气不足，续航能力也不行。
秦峰疯狂的吸收灵石中的灵气，犹如鲸吸水一般。
周围的灵石以肉眼可见的速度减少。
穆无双感受到了这股动静，也一脸的惊愕，没想到一个炼气期居然能闹出这么大动静。
比自己当年还要强，看来这二徒弟是厚积薄发了。
她心中很是高兴。
杀剑锋这些年一直被其他峰耻笑，说她后继无人，这回看谁还敢嘲笑她！
宗门内，秦峰以炼气秒金丹的事情已经传得沸沸扬扬。
任务殿旁，由于很多人都在这里交易，便形成了一个小型的交易场。
一个圆脸的小胖子，身材像球一样，前面摆着一个摊位，周围围了一群人，却没有一个买东西的。
都是来听他讲之前发生的事情，一人问道：“胖子，于川师兄真的是被秦峰一剑打残的？”
“秦峰不是穆师叔最废的徒弟吗？才炼气六成吧，一天就知道喝酒，他能秒了于川师兄？”
小胖子傲然道：“肤浅，天才的世界怎么能用普通境界去衡量？”
“秦峰师兄可是将万剑归宗练到了化境，而且还领悟了剑意。”
这小胖子是影剑锋的商世杰，入门一百年了，依然是筑基期。
主要是因为他的心思都不在修炼上，整天就琢磨怎么做买卖，再就是聊八卦。
反正只要不是修炼，他对什么都感兴趣，最终他师父无奈，也不管他了。
那弟子一点惊讶道：“练到化境？万剑归宗可是地级剑法，就算长老练到这个程度也得几百年吧？”
“秦峰师兄也不过二十多岁，难道喝酒可以增加对剑道的领悟？”
一句话点醒梦中人，周围众人都开始琢磨起来，有的人已经考虑要不要从四师叔那里买点酒来喝。

商世杰一脸鄙视道：“秦峰师兄只是喜欢喝酒，人家的剑道天赋是天生的。”
“你们这帮废柴就算喝成酒桶也没卵用！”
一名弟子不屑道：“胖子，你还有脸说别人，你还不是一个鸟样！”
“入门一百多年了，才筑基期！”
说完众人都哈哈大笑起来。
商世杰昂起高傲的头颅，不屑道：“我那是不想修炼，如果我想，呼吸间超过你们，尔等皆是蝼蚁！”
“我的天赋也就比秦峰师兄差那么一点点。”
此话一出，顿时引起周围人嘘声一片。
平南城
这是一座三星城池，处在人魔战场的偏后方位置，一青年手拿玉简，面色阴沉。
这玉简是天机阁每日向各城发送的玄界灵闻，其中包括各地战况，修士排行榜，还有一些趣闻要事。
而今天最劲爆的消息就是凌霄剑宗杀剑锋的酒痴秦峰以炼气秒金丹，而对象就是于川。
此人正是重剑峰的陈玉龙，金丹中期修为，于川可是他从小看着长大的师弟。
这次师父栽了个大跟头，平时杀剑锋一直被其他峰瞧不起，这次却踩着重剑峰翻身了？
content_en:
But the realm is not enough, and the disadvantages are also obvious. The power cannot be exerted to the extreme, and due to the lack of true energy, the battery life is also not good.
Qin Feng frantically absorbed the spiritual energy in the spirit stone, just like a whale absorbing water.
The surrounding spirit stones decrease at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Mu Wushuang felt the commotion and looked shocked. He didn't expect that such a big commotion could occur during the Qi Refining Period.
He is even stronger than he was back then. It seems that these two apprentices have accumulated a lot of experience.
She was very happy.
Sha Jianfeng has been ridiculed by other peaks over the years, saying that she has no successor. Let's see who dares to laugh at her this time!
In the sect, the news about Qin Feng using Qi to refine the golden elixir has been widely spread.
Next to the mission hall, because many people were trading here, a small trading place was formed.
There was a little fat man with a round face and a ball-like figure. There was a stall in front of him, and there were a group of people around him, but no one was buying anything.
They all came to listen to him talk about what happened before. One person asked: "Fat man, was Senior Brother Yu Chuan really disabled by Qin Feng's sword?"
"Isn't Qin Feng the most useless disciple of Uncle Mu? He has only reached 60% of Qi refining, and he only knows how to drink in a day. How can he defeat Senior Brother Yu Chuan in seconds?"
The little fat man said proudly: "Surface, how can the world of genius be measured by the ordinary realm?"
"Senior Brother Qin Feng has trained Wanjian Guizong to the transformation state, and he has also understood the meaning of the sword."
This little fat guy is Shang Shijie from Shadow Blade. He has been in the industry for a hundred years and is still in the foundation building stage.
Mainly because his mind is not on cultivation. He spends all day thinking about how to do business and gossiping.
Anyway, as long as it was not cultivation, he was interested in everything. In the end, his master had no choice but to ignore him.
The disciple was a little surprised and said: "Practice to the transformation state? Wanjian Guizong is an earth-level swordsmanship. Even if the elders can practice it to this level, it will take hundreds of years, right?"
"Senior Brother Qin Feng is only in his twenties. Can drinking alcohol increase his understanding of the art of swordsmanship?"
After waking up the dreamer with one sentence, everyone around him began to think about it. Some people were already considering whether to buy some wine from the fourth uncle.
Shang Shijie said with a look of disdain: "Senior Brother Qin Feng just likes to drink. His talent for swordsmanship is innate."
"You losers are useless even if you drink them into wine barrels!"
One disciple said disdainfully: "Fat man, you still have the nerve to criticize others, you are not like a bird!"
"It's been more than a hundred years since I started, and I'm only in the foundation building stage!"
After saying this, everyone burst into laughter.
Shang Shijie raised his arrogant head and said disdainfully: "I don't want to practice. If I wanted to, if I could surpass you in one breath, you would all be ants!"
"My talent is only a little bit worse than that of Senior Brother Qin Feng."
As soon as these words came out, people around him immediately booed.
Pingnancheng
This is a three-star city located at the rear of the battlefield between humans and demons. A young man holds a jade slip in his hand with a gloomy expression.
This jade slip is the mystical news sent by Tianji Pavilion to various cities every day, including war status in various places, monk rankings, and some interesting news.
The most exciting news today is that Qin Feng, the drunkard who killed Jianfeng from the Lingxiao Sword Sect, used Qi to refine the golden elixir, and the target was Yu Chuan.
This person is Chen Yulong from Chongjian Peak, who is in the middle stage of Jindan cultivation. Yu Chuan is the junior brother he has watched since childhood.
This time the master suffered a huge setback. Normally, Killing Jianfeng has always been looked down upon by other peaks, but this time he stepped on Heavy Sword Peak and turned around?
